## About the Digital Sufism Project

This website offers digital resources for the study of early Islamic mysticism, with a focus on primary sources from the formative period (3rd/9th to 5th/11th centuries). The project aims to address gaps in the availability and accessibility of early Sufi literature and to promote computational methodologies for historical analysis.

## Jeremy Farrell

I am a scholar of early Islamic mysticism specializing in the formative period of Sufism. My research applies computational methods, particularly network analysis, to the study of early Sufi texts and their transmission.

For my complete academic CV and publications, please visit my [Academia.edu profile](https://emory.academia.edu/JeremyFarrell/CurriculumVitae).
